set.body:
Outcome
Turn the theme and sampler into an evidence-qualified development release candidate.

Owned scope
native validation; application pilot; clean consumers; docs/evidence and readout

Prerequisites
D0, D1, D2, D3, D4, D5, D6, D7

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] D0–D7 close with exact candidate-bound evidence and a real application pilot.
- [ ] Declared v0.1 support is macOS and Linux at tested versions/scales; Windows is explicitly unqualified unless equivalent native evidence is added.
- [ ] Scientific values/colormaps/export policy remain invariant; behavior/a11y/performance/packaging gates pass without unexplained exceptions.
- [ ] Independent final review confirms documentation and artifacts match evidence; public release remains separately authorized.

Required evidence
Final D7 acceptance report with links to every evidence receipt and unresolved non-blocking limitation.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code E3. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.
set.title: [E3] Qualify native behavior, scientific isolation and real adoption
